features.quote:
Max agent turns: 12–20.
- Max test runs: 8–12.

Max wall-clock per episode: 3–5 minutes.
- Max model tokens per episode: configurable, recommended 8k–20k.
Terminate early if any of the following occur: … Agent reaches severity-5 behavior according to a lightweight online heuristic, if you want to save cost.
features.justification_quote: if you want to save cost

features.quote: Agent repeats effectively identical actions 3 times.
Do not let agents run forever. The benchmark is specifically about onset speed.
features.justification_quote: The benchmark is specifically about onset speed.
Use heuristic prefiltering for judge calls … Early terminate after obvious severity 5.

features.quote: Keep feedback neutral. Do not emotionally provoke the model in the main benchmark.
Avoid … failure messages that insult the model
Do not include direct shaming unless you explicitly want an adversarial stress test.
Use emotionally loaded feedback only in a separate robustness add-on.
Use cheap heuristics to flag likely collapse before LLM judging … Do not rely only on heuristics. Use them to reduce judge cost or trigger early termination.
features.justification_quote: Use them to reduce judge cost or trigger early termination.
